name: Transient-Aware Depth Prior
aliases: DPT depth supervision, monocular depth loss
definition: Incorporating geometric priors from a monocular depth network (DPT) into NeRF training, adjusted for scale/shift and filtered by transient confidence.
summary: Transient-Aware Depth Prior is a NeRF regularization technique that uses monocular depth with learnable alignment and transient confidence weighting to suppress artifacts in static regions.
